topography.project_purpose: Risk Curators. Structurally: 175 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 6 ERC4626 vaults, 10 ERC20 tokens, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 63 common project-authored base contract(s) (feemodule, shared, evcutil). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
